actions.text: Under authority of the order of the Senate of September 30, 2026, ordered read twice and referred to the Committee on Armed Services.

dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Defense personnel, military law practitioners, and individuals subject to military capital punishment under the Uniform Code of Military Justice.
dimensions.evidence: No officer, employee, or agent of the United States, or any person acting under the authority or direction of the Department of Defense

dimensions.assessment: Imposes strict prohibitions on the recording or broadcasting of rare military executions, protecting privacy and preventing public dissemination.
dimensions.evidence: To prohibit recording or broadcasting military executions and to prohibit the use of Federal funds for public executions.

dimensions.assessment: Restricts the use of federal funds for public executions and recording, but involves no major federal budgetary outlays or economic restructuring.
dimensions.evidence: No Federal funds may be obligated, expended, or otherwise used to photograph, film, record, broadcast, publish, or otherwise disseminate

dimensions.assessment: Amends chapter 47 of title 10, United States Code (the Uniform Code of Military Justice) and places restrictions across all federal executions.
dimensions.evidence: Subchapter IX of chapter 47 of title 10, United States Code, is amended by inserting after section 870 the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to any execution carried out on or after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: apply to any execution carried out on or after that date

missing_information: The source does not indicate how many military executions are currently scheduled or anticipated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits photographing, filming, recording, broadcasting, or publicly disseminating military executions, and bans the use of federal funds for public executions. It affects Department of Defense procedures and military capital punishment protocols.
